items.title: Warren Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 17, 2018
items.q: you know we had Connie Kay playing drums

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. We did all these things in maybe like two sessions. And the main problem, it was not him, it wasn’t the music, the music was, you know we had Connie Kay playing drums and maybe George Duvivier playing — you know all these masters. I was honored to be among their company. But he was — no it was Richard Davis was the bass player. But he was probably scared to death of all of us. And he very seldom even communicated other than well this is the next song I’m going to do. Very shy and kind of…
What shape was the music in? Was it chord charts? Do you know?
